job_event_location_chk.name: job_event_location_chk
job_event_location_chk.value: ("job_event"."lat" is null and "job_event"."lng" is null and "job_event"."accuracy_m" is null and "job_event"."captured_at" is null) or "job_event"."to_status" = 'on_site'

service_job_window_chk.name: service_job_window_chk
service_job_window_chk.value: ("service_job"."scheduled_start" is null) = ("service_job"."scheduled_end" is null) and ("service_job"."scheduled_start" is null or ("service_job"."scheduled_end" > "service_job"."scheduled_start" and "service_job"."scheduled_end" <= "service_job"."scheduled_start" + interval '12 hours'))

site_coords_chk.name: site_coords_chk
site_coords_chk.value: ("site"."lat" is null) = ("site"."lng" is null) and ("site"."lat" is null or ("site"."lat" between -90 and 90 and "site"."lng" between -180 and 180))
